_설명: 천일문 2권 Chapter 11 접속사 Chapter Test 뒷장 가운데 간접의문문 문항(17·20번)을 변형한 것. 기본 15과 접속사[2] 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 두 문장을 한 문장으로 잘못 연결한 것을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Do you remember? + What did he order?  → Do you remember what he ordered?
The sign shows. + Where did the bus stop?  → The sign shows where did the bus stop.
Tell me. + Whom did you invite last week?  → Tell me whom you invited last week.
I wonder. + Will it rain tomorrow?  → I wonder if it will rain tomorrow.
Can you guess? + Does Mia like jazz?  → Can you guess whether does Mia like jazz?

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Can you show me [[where is the nearest bank]]?
I can’t decide [[whether I will join the trip]].
Leo didn’t tell me [[why did he leave early]].
Do you know [[when the store opens]]?
We aren’t sure [[if it will rain on Friday]].
